1. **Confounding Claim**: When judge severity (d_j) and contamination susceptibility (c_n·e_i) are both present but only one is modeled, the unmodeled facet's effect is absorbed into other parameter estimates, producing systematic bias in model ability rankings. - **Problem**: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation has bifurcated into two correction silos — judge bias and benchmark contamination — that are addressed independently.
